scope: Timestamp normalization preserving raw values and confidence while leaving unknown zones, RFC3339 -00:00 markers, DST fall-back overlap ambiguity, and DST spring-forward gaps explicit rather than fabricating UTC, backed by bounded atomic TimeStore recovery

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

Passed all 11 tests in cmd/breachatlas and all test suites in tests (C05 through C17, including all 5 C17 timestamp normalization, explicit unknown-zone/DST ambiguity, boundary rejection, interrupted restart recovery, sealed immutability, and race tests).
Plan validation, TypeScript check, Vite build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked repository JSON files and contract invariants.

observations: NormalizeTimestamp in internal/timeline/time.go preserves raw_timestamp verbatim and retains supplied source confidence alongside explicit normalized_timestamp, timezone_status, and timezone_offset.
Zoneless timestamps without a ZoneHint, RFC3339 -00:00 unknown-offset markers, and unrecognized ZoneHints yield TimezoneStatus='unknown_zone' with NormalizedTimestamp='' rather than fabricating UTC.

DST fall-back overlaps in IANA zones (e.g., 2026-11-01T01:30:00 in America/New_York) yield TimezoneStatus='dst_ambiguous', NormalizedTimestamp='', and explicit candidate_utcs/candidate_offsets instead of choosing one fold arbitrarily.
DST spring-forward gaps (e.g., 2026-03-08T02:30:00 in America/New_York) yield TimezoneStatus='dst_nonexistent' with NormalizedTimestamp=''.

TimeStore rejects malformed timestamps, unsupported schema_version, oversized inputs, path traversals (in IDs and zone_hint), and symlink paths before staging or committing, cleans interrupted staging temps on restart while preserving prior committed batches, and leaves sealed source bytes untouched.

observed_limitations: Stable derived timeline event identity indexing and cross-run deduplication (C18) are deferred to their planned task.
